raw.denial_quote: These files enable DoubleClick to recognize a unique cookie on your Web browser, which in turn enables us to learn which advertisements bring users to our website. It does not contain your name, address, telephone number, or email address. In short, web beacons collect only a limited amount of information including cookies and time and date of viewing and do not contain personally identifiable information.
